narratives.headline: Morgan Hale joins Bay Owls; club denies agreement
narratives.body: Arena Desk reports that Morgan Hale has agreed to join the Bay Owls, citing an unnamed source, while the club has not commented. Conversely, Club Ledger states that the Bay Owls deny any agreement with Morgan Hale.
